meta.title: Weekly rotating globe categories (Fire TV)
meta.how_it_works: Each week feature ONE of the 5 new categories as the default globe filter, plus 3 evergreen spotlights from the core 15. Change featured_category on week_start. On Firestick, map Left/Right on the category row and Autoplay a 20s pin tour.
engagement_loop: Pin focus: big visual_stat + one-line fact (10-foot UI)
End of tour CTA: Next week preview chip
Optional: remember last 3 viewed pins in local storage
meta.how_heatmaps_work: When featured_render is heatmap, draw a Gaussian density field from that category's points (weight = heat_weight). Keep pin mode for iconic one-off sites (stadiums, towers, spaceports). On Firestick: heat is the ambient layer; top 3 hotspots remain focusable with the remote.

The factories filling the world's EVs and grid storage.
new_categories.heatmap_note: Weekly rotator: EV manufacturing belts (China, EU, US Midwest) as heat.

new_categories.weekly_hook: Where natural gas becomes ships of energy for the world.
Trading floors and matching engines that move global capital.
The pits and shafts behind EVs, turbines, and defense tech.
new_categories.heatmap_note: Weekly rotator: copper/lithium/cobalt belts as resource heat, not mine icons.
